summary.text: André Jacque is a member of the Wisconsin State Senate for the 1st Senate District, and his official biography lists him as a full-time legislator.

paragraphs.text: Jacque was born in Beaver Dam, Wisconsin, on October 13, 1980, according to his official biography.
The page says he graduated from Green Bay Southwest in 1999, earned a B.S. from UW-Madison in 2003 and holds a graduate certificate from the La Follette Institute of Public Affairs.

It lists his former work as transit planning coordinator, communications director and grant-writing consultant, and his membership in groups including the Wisconsin Council on Domestic Abuse, Green Bay Area Crimestoppers and the Knights of Columbus.
The page also lists awards including the Wisconsin Counties Association Outstanding Legislator Award and the NFIB Guardian of Small Business Award.
